title: spears-limiter
description: spears-limiter is a light weight plugin that adds spear limiter for every type of spear
body:
SpearLimiter

SpearLimiter is a lightweight and highly configurable Minecraft plugin that allows server owners to control how many spears can be crafted on their server.

Each spear type has its own independent crafting limit, giving you complete control over progression, balance, and item rarity. All limits can be easily customized through the configuration file, allowing you to tailor the plugin to your server's needs.

Features
Limit the number of crafted spears per spear type.
Individual limits for every spear variant.
Fully configurable through a simple config file.
Lightweight and performance-friendly.
Easy setup with minimal impact on server resources.
Ideal for balancing custom items and maintaining server economy.

Whether you're running a survival, RPG, or custom gameplay server, SpearLimiter provides a simple and efficient way to manage spear availability while keeping your server balanced and enjoyable.
